item.title: Privacy Policy
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Who we are

Suggested text: Our website address is: https://YOUR-DOMAIN.com.

Comments

Suggested text: When visitors leave comments on the site we collect the data shown in the comments form, and also the visitor’s IP address and browser user agent string to help spam detection.

An anonymized string created from your email address (also called a hash) may be provided to the Gravatar service to see if you are using it. The Gravatar service privacy policy is available here: https://automattic.com/privacy/. After approval of your comment, your profile picture is visible to the public in the context of your comment.

Media

Suggested text: If you upload images to the website, you should avoid uploading images with embedded location data (EXIF GPS) included. Visitors to the website can download and extract any location data from images on the website.

Cookies

Suggested text: If you leave a comment on our site you may opt-in to saving your name, email address and website in cookies. These are for your convenience so that you do not have to fill in your details again when you leave another comment. These cookies will last for one year.

If you visit our login page, we will set a temporary cookie to determine if your browser accepts cookies. This cookie contains no personal data and is discarded when you close your browser.

When you log in, we will also set up several cookies to save your login information and your screen display choices. Login cookies last for two days, and screen options cookies last for a year. If you select "Remember Me", your login will persist for two weeks. If you log out of your account, the login cookies will be removed.

If you edit or publish an article, an additional cookie will be saved in your browser. This cookie includes no personal data and simply indicates the post ID of the article you just edited. It expires after 1 day.

Embedded content from other websites

Suggested text: Articles on this site may include embedded content (e.g. videos, images, articles, etc.). Embedded content from other websites behaves in the exact same way as if the visitor has visited the other website.

These websites may collect data about you, use cookies, embed additional third-party tracking, and monitor your interaction with that embedded content, including tracking your interaction with the embedded content if you have an account and are logged in to that website.

Who we share your data with

Suggested text: If you request a password reset, your IP address will be included in the reset email.

How long we retain your data

Suggested text: If you leave a comment, the comment and its metadata are retained indefinitely. This is so we can recognize and approve any follow-up comments automatically instead of holding them in a moderation queue.

For users that register on our website (if any), we also store the personal information they provide in their user profile. All users can see, edit, or delete their personal information at any time (except they cannot change their username). Website administrators can also see and edit that information.

What rights you have over your data

Suggested text: If you have an account on this site, or have left comments, you can request to receive an exported file of the personal data we hold about you, including any data you have provided to us. You can also request that we erase any personal data we hold about you. This does not include any data we are obliged to keep for administrative, legal, or security purposes.

Where your data is sent

Suggested text: Visitor comments may be checked through an automated spam detection service.

item.title: About
item.content:encoded:
Meet your artist

Lead Artist & Owner

Willow & Veil

●

Willow & Veil is more than just a business to me — it’s a dream built from years of passion, creativity and a genuine love for making people feel beautiful. After spending over 8 years as a professional makeup artist in the UK, specialising in bridal beauty, I’ve had the privilege of being part of so many special moments and getting to know the incredible women behind them. I’ve always believed that bridal makeup should never hide who you are, but enhance what already makes you feel beautiful and confident. Now, I’m bringing that passion, experience and my own personal journey across the pond to Austin, Texas, where I’m starting a brand-new chapter with Willow & Veil. It’s a huge leap, but one that feels so exciting — creating something of my own, building a beautiful community and continuing to do what I love most: helping women feel confident, radiant and completely themselves on their most special days.

I can’t wait to be part of your story. ♡

item.title: FAQ
item.content:encoded:
FAQ

Frequently asked questions

Everything you need to know about booking bridal hair and makeup with Willow & Veil in Austin, Texas.

How do I book or enquire?

Please email contact@willowandveil.com with all the following information: date, time, location and how many people. I will try to respond to all messages within 48 hours.

Is a deposit required to reserve my date?

A signed agreement and 30% non-refundable retainer are required to reserve your wedding date. Final payment is due 14 days before the wedding.

Full payment terms are on the Investment page.

What happens to my retainer if I cancel?

This retainer is non-refundable and non-transferable for any reason.

Do you offer a trial before the wedding?

Yes. Bridal Makeup Preview $185 and Bridal Hair Preview $185: a dedicated appointment to design and perfect your wedding-day look.

Do you travel to our venue?

Complimentary within 20 miles of Austin. Additional mileage and destination wedding rates are quoted based on location.

Is there a minimum booking?

Friday & Sunday Weddings: $750 service minimum. Saturday Weddings: $1,000 service minimum. Service minimums apply before travel, parking, and additional artist fees.

How large a bridal party can you look after?

Our Wedding Party Collections bring a team sized to your morning:

  • The Cotswold Collection, $2,800: Team of 2 artists · Bride + 6 guests · Hair & makeup
  • The Oxford Collection, $3,700: Team of 3 artists · Bride + 9 guests · Hair & makeup
  • The English Rose Collection, $4,575: Team of 4 artists · Bride + 12 guests · Hair & makeup

Ask about adding guests to any collection.

What time will you arrive, and how long does each look take?

Your Willow & Veil team will carefully curate a personalised schedule for your wedding morning, ensuring every detail runs smoothly and everyone is ready with plenty of time to spare. From the first brush stroke to the final touch, we’ll coordinate the morning seamlessly so you can relax, enjoy the moment and feel completely taken care of.

Can you stay for touch-ups during the day?

Extended Touch-Up Service, $175 per hour. Perfect for photography touch-ups, pre-ceremony maintenance, and bridal party refreshments.

Can I change my look for the reception?

Bridal Look Change, $300.

Do you offer services for junior bridesmaids and flower girls?

Junior Bridesmaid Makeup, $125. Flower Girl Beauty Touch, $50. Includes age-appropriate blush, lip color, and light finishing touches.

What products do you use?

We use high-quality products and techniques to ensure your hair and makeup look flawless in person and in every photo.

Still have a question?

I can’t wait to be part of your story.

Inquire
